prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: wedding invitation gallery photograph
Primary request: Create a new cinematic editorial photograph of the exact same fictional couple from Image 1 walking together through a twilight conservatory garden after their ceremony.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity, wardrobe, photographic style, and color reference; preserve both faces, skin tones, hair, age, body proportions, ivory dress, black tuxedo, white shirt, and black bow tie consistently, but create a genuinely new moment and composition.
Scene/backdrop: elegant glasshouse interior and garden path at blue hour, dark glossy leaves, conservatory ironwork fading into cool dusk, sparse warm champagne lantern glow, black-cherry foliage accents, no readable signage and no other people.
Subject: Amara and Julian walk shoulder-to-shoulder along the path in a quiet candid moment, turning slightly toward one another; both hands are entirely concealed behind their bodies or outside the frame, with no bouquet or handheld object.
Style/medium: cinematic natural editorial wedding photography, photorealistic, realistic skin pores, fine hair, true silk and wool texture, restrained film grain, luxury magazine storytelling.
Composition/framing: vertical portrait for an arched responsive crop, three-quarter view from mid-thigh upward with clear environmental context; the couple occupies the central safe area and faces remain fully visible; no visible hands anywhere in frame.
Lighting/mood: intimate blue-hour ambience, soft champagne rim light, reflective glass and deep readable shadows, romantic and observational rather than posed.
Color palette: black cherry, oxblood, muted mauve, ivory, antique champagne, cool twilight blue; controlled saturation and natural skin color.
Constraints: preserve the exact same fictional people from Image 1; obviously a demo wedding image rather than documentary evidence; anatomically natural; no text, no logo, no watermark, no phone, no visible hands, no extra people.
Avoid: bright daytime greenhouse, rustic styling, bridal catalog pose, plastic skin, glamour retouching, rose-gold fog, artificial lens flare, painterly treatment, CGI, identity drift, duplicate faces, cropped heads.
